name: parcel-watch
description: Package tracking and delivery estimates for agents

plugins.name: parcel-watch
plugins.description: Package tracking with up-to-date delivery estimates from the FedEx and UPS tracking APIs, Amazon's public tracker, and Ship24 for USPS, DHL, and other carriers. Watches packages and reports when a status or delivery estimate changes. Requires Python 3.9+ and your own carrier API keys.
